description: Use this to answer 'what would Shadow Mode have held recently?' by listing recent SHADOW evaluations in the environment-bound organization across price, inventory, order, fulfillment, promotion, refund, and return proposals. Results describe what policy would have done; they do not report marketplace execution and must not be interpreted as authority to mutate commerce state.

days.description: Report window in days. The API default is 30.

limit.description: Maximum report rows to inspect. The API default is 20.

name: commercegate_list_shadow_reports
title: List CommerceGate Shadow Reports
